description: This file serves as the entry point for a React web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by creating a root and rendering the App component within React.StrictMode inside an element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to manage the React component tree for the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM within the root.
